excluded.SI-VAKTIJA: seasonalSweep. A per-day hand-tuned angle curve with clamps and no angle pair behind it, so approximating it into angles would invent the target
excluded.UA-DUMU: intervalTable. Fajr is sunrise minus 100 minutes every day and isha is maghrib plus a dated interval ramp of 90 to 100 minutes, so no angle exists to score
excluded.AT-IZW: seasonalSweep. A per-day sweep from about 15.6 degrees in winter to about 11.3 at the solstice, which a frozen pair cannot express
excluded.FR-GMS: seasonalSweep. Fajr sweeps 18 to 12 degrees and isha 16 to 11.5 over the year, and no frozen adhan parameter set encodes it
